binding.variables: only the four declared role variables
binding.same_variable_in_multiple_positions: permitted unless forbidden by an explicit parent predicate definition

canonicalization: alpha-normalize bound roles in first-appearance order using target, intervention, contrast, context
canonicalize predicate argument order according to the parent grammar
sort conjunction atoms by canonical atom serialization
serialize as UTF-8 JSON with sorted ASCII keys and no insignificant whitespace

enumeration.contradiction_policy: validation metadata only; never confidence- or majority-resolved

blocker: The parent protocol text establishes the relational predicate vocabulary but the inspected normative material does not establish that SERL's two-element consequence domain {ENABLES(target), NONENABLES(contrast,target)} is the complete parent prediction domain. The grammar therefore remains non-authorizing until that scientific choice is resolved.
